description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin on Tuesday defended his use of a government plane to fly to the LSU-Texas college football game the day after a nationwide ground stop that caused massive travel disruptions and left people stranded across the country. Mullin, speaking on CNBC, acknowledged earlier reporting in the New York Post that he flew to the game a day after all planes were grounded. Mullin's flight took place after the stoppage was lifted and as flights were back in the air. description: In today’s newsletter: Guaranteed jobs and expanded employment support sit alongside Alan Milburn’s proposals to cut benefits for some of Britain’s million young people not in education, work or training Good morning. The former health secretary, Alan Milburn, will publish his long-awaited review into the one million young people not in education, employment or training (Neets) later today. The report will propose cutting welfare for some under-25s and spending billions on a new “deal” for young people. One of the building's walls had torn off, exposing the inside of several apartment homes, and the rubble had collapsed into a construction site next door.
